stance_rationale: The optimizer package has enough time-series rows to avoid a pure single-date file, but it fails deployable hard-constraint verification: the schedule is sleeve-level with a 70% placeholder and 30% KR10y weights on many dates, while the expanded deploy snapshot has 27 nonzero tickers versus the hard max_names=20. Method selection and cost-adjusted admission are also unresolved because net_IR, beta, TE, TDC, and Forge walk-forward expansion evidence are missing or deferred.

method_shopping_audit.selection_method: Exogenous Path C 70/15/15; alternatives rejected by user framing without net_ir or cost-adjusted comparison.

cost_audit.cost_proportionality_check: FAIL/AMBIGUOUS: role checklist formula turnover * 15bps * 2 gives 0.0173 if turnover is one-way; package labels turnover round-trip but applies only *0.0015, so cost units are not auditable.

hard_constraint_violations: RF-O5: expanded deploy snapshot has 27 nonzero unique tickers, above max_names=20 hard.
RF-O6: stage weights.csv has STR_1715_RISK_SLEEVE weight 0.70 on every date, above 0.20 per-name cap.
RF-O6: even excluding the sleeve placeholder, A148070 reaches 0.30 on pre-2015 dates, above 0.20 global hard cap.
RF-O6/RF-O8: package rf_r8_disposition reports post-cap breaches and pass=false for TSMOM internal 30% cap handling.

sequential_admission_audit.integration_weight_breakdown: Not reported; package gives a full book mutation to 70/15/15 but no Replacement vs Integration scenario or TDC vs PG2/MEGA_05.

critical_concerns.description: No single artifact satisfies hard constraints at deployable security level. The time-series weights.csv is sleeve-level and contains STR_1715_RISK_SLEEVE at 0.70, while the expanded deploy snapshot has 27 nonzero tickers; therefore either max_w<=0.20 or max_names<=20 fails depending on which representation Forge uses.

The global 20% cap is breached in the time-series schedule: A148070 reaches 0.30 on 119 dates when pre-2015 TSMOM capital is renormalized into KR10y, and the package reports max_target_weight only for the 2026-06-01 deploy snapshot, hiding the schedule-level breach.

Walk-forward evidence is incomplete. The package has 256 as_of_dates, but no current alpha_scores.parquet exists at the requested WT paths, the canonical mailbox weights.csv is absent, method_selected is missing from weights.csv, and the STR_1715 leg is not expanded per date; this leaves a single-snapshot stock-expansion risk for Forge.

Method shopping is not an honest optimizer comparison. Path C is selected because it is user-fixed, while risk parity and inverse-vol are rejected without net_ir, active return, tracking error, or cost-adjusted objective values; selection_objective_value is deferred to Forge.

CVaR95 monthly loss remains -6.75% versus the referenced -2.5% cap. An infeasibility report exists, but it proposes a waiver/default admission rather than a resolved risk cap decision; the optimizer cannot treat inherited improvement versus PG2 as cap compliance.

Cost and turnover accounting is unit-ambiguous near the hard turnover ceiling: turnover is 5.7578 versus a 6.0 cap, but estimated_cost uses 0.86% while the role checklist formula implies about 1.73% under one-way turnover convention. Net_IR is empty, so RF-O2 cannot be cleared.

Iter-specific alignment is incomplete: inherited RF-A1 synthetic ETF/KOFIA validation is still pending, confidence-aware sizing is not applied, crisis small-sample fallback does not shrink boundaries or add a cash sleeve, and beta_port/TE/IR are not measured.

Sequential Admission is not cleared. TDC versus PG2/MEGA_05 is null, Replacement vs Integration scenarios are absent, and AX-008 still has Architect PASS_PARTIAL only with Forge pending and prior Codex risk critique rejected.

supporting_arguments: Covariance artifacts under stage_artifacts are PSD with min_eigenvalue 0.001966966 and condition_number 22.85608, so the 3x3 Sigma numerical check itself passes.
The stage weights.csv has 256 as_of_dates from 2005-02-01 to 2026-05-01, sum_w error below 1e-6, and no negative weights.
Nominal turnover 5.7578 is below the 6.0 hard ceiling if interpreted as decimal annual turnover, but only with narrow margin and unresolved cost units.
Hill alpha is 3.203229 in the risk package, so RF-O12 heavy-tail MVO prohibition is not triggered by supplied estimates.
unresolved_disputes: Is max_names=20 intended to cover only the STR_1715 stock sleeve, or the final deployable book including ETFs? The request hard_constraints says max_names=20 globally.
Can Forge expand STR_1715_RISK_SLEEVE into historical per-date stock holdings without using the 2026-05 deploy snapshot across the full backtest? Current optimizer artifact does not prove this.
Does the 0.30 ETF overlay cap override the global 0.20 per-name cap for A148070 pre-2015, or is this a hard RF-O6 breach?
Is the 5.7578 turnover figure one-way or round-trip for cost purposes? The package and role checklist imply different formulas.
No optimizer_challenge_note.md exists; only a generic challenge_note.md and risk_challenge_note.md are present.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that a sleeve-level 70/15/15 capital schedule can be treated as a deployable optimizer weights schedule while still claiming max_names<=20 and per-name weight<=0.20 across the full walk-forward period.
rebuttal_required: Provide a deployable as_of_date x ticker x weight x method_selected schedule with STR_1715 expanded to actual historical holdings per date, not a 0.70 sleeve token.
Show hard-constraint audit on the expanded schedule: nonzero names<=20, max_w<=0.20, sum_w=1, long-only, liquidity>=2e8 KRW, turnover<600%.
Resolve the A148070 0.30 pre-2015 schedule-level breach or file an explicit hard-constraint infeasibility report with Governor acceptance before admission.
Supply alpha_scores.parquet or an explicit inherited-alpha schedule certificate proving Date x Ticker score coverage and PIT lag for every rebalance date.
Replace Path C-only method shopping with a cost-adjusted comparison including net_IR, beta_port, TE, TDC vs PG2/MEGA_05, and Replacement vs Integration scenarios.
Clarify turnover units and recompute estimated cost under the role checklist formula.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: The optimizer draft treats the user-fixed 70/15/15 framing as sufficient admission logic. External review sees a representation problem first: the package alternates between sleeve-level schedule and expanded deploy snapshot, and neither representation clears all optimizer hard constraints.

optimizer_specific_questions: 이 weights를 22년 시계열에 적용 가능한가? 현재 STR_1715_RISK_SLEEVE 0.70 토큰만으로는 stock-level walk-forward가 검증되지 않는다.
method_shopping에서 Path C가 net_IR, cost-adjusted IR, beta/TE 기준으로도 우위인가, 아니면 user-fixed framing만 반영한 것인가?
RF-O8 CVaR breach waiver는 Governor가 명시 수락했는가, 아니면 optimizer package가 default admit을 제안한 것인가?
Sequential Admission vs PG2 active book TDC는 cross-section 기준인가 time-series 기준인가, 그리고 왜 null인가?
